title: Injective module sheaves are acyclic as abelian sheaves on every object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $I$ be an injective object of the category $\Mod(X_{\Et},R)$ of sheaves of $R_X$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]; write $I_{ab}\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ for its underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For an object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$ let $H^q(U,-)$ be the $q$-th right derived functor of the left exact functor $\Ab(X_{\Et})\to\Ab$, $G\mapsto G(U)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive] (cohomology computed in abelian sheaves, not in modules). Then $H^q(U,I_{ab})=0$ for every object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$ and every $q>0$. ($I_{ab}$ need not be an injective abelian sheaf: the left adjoint $G\mapsto G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}R_X$ of the forgetful functor is not exact in general.)
